experiments.name: dependent vector chain with reset helper
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 1065353216' --asm 'xvfrecip.s $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.w $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: vpickve2gr extracts element 0, and/or forces it back to the test value, vreplgr2vr replicates it; the vadd.b baseline is subtracted.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. 11 for 0, Inf or NaN; 15 when the reciprocal is exact (a power of two); 17 for an exact reciprocal of a subnormal; 25 when the inexact reciprocal is tiny (1.0/max); 27 when the reciprocal needs the full 23-bit mantissa; 29 for that case with a subnormal input. Long path: 15 + 2*ceil(23/4) = 27.

notes: LASX variable-latency floating-point instruction. Latency measured with a reset helper that keeps element 0 at the test value; throughput measured with 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover special values, exact/non-exact cases, subnormals, and overflow/underflow boundaries.
